recentItems.description:
The Sharannavarathri festival at the Bhadrakali Ammavari temple in Tellapad, Kaligiri Mandal, Nellore district, is being celebrated with great grandeur and devotion. The goddess is appearing before devotees in a different avatar each day, drawing large crowds to the temple. Temple priests are performing various traditional rituals, including Kumbha Harati, Nakshatra, Pancha, and Karpura Haratis as offerings to the deity. Devotees have been turning up in large numbers to seek the blessings of the goddess during this auspicious festival.

recentItems.description:
Alliance leaders have accused the YCP mayor candidate in Kadapa of staging an attack on their own home to avoid the election race, attempting to shift the blame onto TDP cadres. Questions were raised about why the CCTV cameras inside the YCP mayor candidate's house were switched off during the night of the incident. Leaders also pointed out that Deepti's husband and former Deputy Mayor Nityananda Reddy has several murder cases registered against him. The alliance leaders made it clear that they themselves had requested the police to conduct a thorough investigation into the attack on the YCP mayor candidate's residence.

recentItems.description:
Israel's upcoming parliamentary elections next week have become a critical test for Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's political future. The northern border city of Kiryat Shmona, which has long been a stronghold for Netanyahu and his Likud party for decades, is now witnessing a dramatic shift in public sentiment. Three years of intense conflict with Hezbollah in Lebanon has devastated the lives of residents in the region. As a result, Netanyahu's support in northern Israel has sharply declined from 29 percent in 2022 to just 17 percent, signaling growing discontent among his once-loyal voter base.

recentItems.description:
YS Jagan Warning to YSRCP MLAs and Incharges on Andhra Pradesh Local body election unanimous wins is now going viral on social media. In a past review meetings, YS Jagan gave a strict ultimatum that YSRCP leaders who allow unanimous wins in local body elections will lose their assembly tickets.However, during the current Pulivendula municipal elections, YCP candidates failed to file nominations in over 22 wards out of 40. Following this, Social Media Trolls and Memes have erupted, asking if Jagan's ticket logic applies to himself as well.
